result.summary: The page layout is mostly clean; one notable issue is the 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name being cut off due to text truncation width, not edge clipping, indicating potential text overflow handling issue.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or indication of truncation, appearing as if the text is broken or incomplete rather than intentionally shortened.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis ('...') or reduce font size/adjust card width to ensure full restaurant names are legible or clearly truncated with visual indication.
